# Bihar Aur Purnea Maize Market Report — 2 May 2026 (Shanivaar)

## Aaj Ka Sabse Zaroori Hal-Chal: Teen Badi Bullish Khabaren — Daam Upar!

**Kisan bhai, aaj 2 May 2026 (Shanivaar) ko Purnea mandi mein makka ka daam ₹1,900 per quintal (100 kilo) chal raha hai** — 30 April ke ₹1,869 se ₹31 UPAR. Do din mein itni barkat kyun aayi? Aaj hum teen badi khabaren batayenge jo daam ko upar le gayi hain — lekin saath hi yeh bhi batayenge ki aage kya hoga.

## Pehli Khabar — Iran Ki Ladai Mein Tel Bahut Mehnga

**Iran ki ladai** (jo February 28 ko shuru hui thi) mein Strait of Hormuz (ek zaroori samandar ka rasta jisse duniya ka 20% tel aata hai) abhi bhi band hai. Is wajah se tel (Brent Crude — duniya ka benchmark tel) is hafte ₹126.41 dollar per barrel tak pahuncha — yeh 4 saalon ka record HIGH tha! Aaj ₹108.83 par band hua — thoda neeche aaya kyunki America-Iran ke beech peace ki baatein chal rahi hain. Lekin ladai abhi bhi jaari hai.

**Makka ke liye yeh kyun zaroori hai?** Jab tel mehnga hota hai, sarkar aur factories makka se alcohol (ethanol — jo petrol mein milaya jaata hai) banana bahut ZAROORI ho jaata hai. Is se makka ki demand bahut badhti hai. Distillery wale (makka se alcohol banane wale) khulkar khareed rahe hain abhi!

## Doosri Khabar — Bihar Mein Orange Alert Aur Crop Damage

**IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka mausam vibhag) ne Bihar ke liye Orange Alert jaari kiya** — heavy rain (bhaari baarish), thunderstorms (bade toofan), aur 60 kmph ki tez hawayen. Kai zilon mein hailstorm (ole girna) bhi hua. Patna, Purnea, aur aas-paas ke zilon mein crop damage (fasal ko nuksan) ki khabaren hain.

**Kisan ke liye yeh acha kaise hua?** Jab baarish aur toofan hota hai, nayi katai hui makka mandi mein aana RUK JAATI hai — kyunki rasste band ho jaate hain ya geeli makka bechne ka sahi time nahi hota. Kam maal mandi mein aaya toh daam upar gaya. May 2026 mein above-normal rainfall ki forecast IMD ne di hai.

## Teesri Khabar — CBOT Aur NCDEX Bullish Signal

**CBOT (America ka bada maize bazaar) mein July 2026 ka contract 480.25 cents per bushel par chal raha hai** — is hafte +1.16% ki tezi. USDA ne bataya ki March 2026 mein ethanol banane ke liye makka ka upyog 10.2% ZYADA hua — yeh bohot accha signal hai. Managed money investors (bade fund managers jo profit ke liye kharid-bikri karte hain) ne 79,697 naye kharidi ke contracts daale.

**NCDEX (Delhi ka bada fasal bazaar) mein makka ka June 2026 future ₹1,940 par hai** — Purnea ke aaj ke ₹1,900 se ₹40 UPAR. Yeh 'Buy' signal de raha hai — matlab bade traders bol rahe hain ki daam aur badhenge.

## Lekin Aage Ka Kya Hoga?

**Dhyan rakho: rabi fasal (sardi mein boi aur April-May mein kati jaane wali makka) ka peak arrivals time abhi bhi chal raha hai.** Bihar mein 15% zyada fasal is saal aayi hai. Orange Alert toot gaya toh makka phir mandi mein aaega aur daam girenge. Agle 10 din mein daam ₹1,842 tak aa sakta hai.

## Kisan Bhai Ke Liye Clear Advice

- **Jo bechna chahte hain:** Aaj ₹1,900 mil raha hai. Agar quality acchi hai (moisture 12% se kam), toh aaj ya Somwar (Monday) ko bech do. Agle 2 hafte mein Orange Alert hatega aur arrivals badhengi — daam ₹1,842 tak aa sakta hai.
- **Jo khareedna chahte hain (murgi-wale, factory-wale):** Thoda ruko — 10-12 May ke baad rabi fasal tapering phase mein aayegi. Tab ₹1,840-₹1,850 ka moka milega. Abhi mat kharido jab daam upar chal raha hai.
- **MSP gap abhi bhi ₹500 hai** — sarkar ne tay kiya ₹2,400, mandi de raha ₹1,900. Yeh gap jab tak rahega, daan press mein rahega.
- **12 May ko America ki nayi WASDE report aayegi** — agar Brazil mein makka zyada dikhaya toh global daam gir sakta hai, India par bhi asar aayega.

news_items.title: E20 mandate post-launch normalized — distillery structural demand stable, AIDA E30 ki maang continue

news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** E20 mandate (sarkar ka niyam ki petrol mein 20% alcohol milana LAZMI hai — 1 April 2026 se shuru) ab 31 din purana ho gaya hai. Distillery wale (makka se alcohol banane wali factories) ab normal speed se khareed rahe hain — na jaldi, na dheere. AIDA (All India Distillers Association — poore India ki sharab banane wali factories ki sanstha) ne E30 (petrol mein 30% alcohol) ki maang sarkar se continue ki hui hai. India ke total ethanol mein 45.68% hissa makka ka hai. Lekin April mein jo 'pre-buy sprint' (jaldi-jaldi kharidna) ki rush thi, woh khatam ho gayi — ab normal demand hai. Yeh neutral situation hai — na bahut acchi, na buri.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Distillery walon ki demand stable hai — woh ₹1,870-₹1,920 ke range mein khareedenge. Yeh ek floor (neeche ka base daam — jis se neeche daam nahi girega asaani se) banata hai. AIDA agar E30 la liya toh aur badi demand aayegi.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Distillery walon ko aaj bhi bech sakte ho. Normal demand chal rahi hai.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: E30 agar aaya toh daam aur upar jaayenge — dhyan rakho sarkar ki announcement par.

news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** Purnea mandi mein aaj makka ₹1,900 per quintal (100 kilo) chal rahi hai. Sarkar ne MSP (Minimum Support Price — matlab sarkar ne tay kiya hua floor daam — woh lowest daam jis se kam mein makka nahi bikni chahiye) ₹2,400 per quintal rakha hai 2025-26 season ke liye.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** ₹1,900 vs ₹2,400 = ₹500 ka seedha nuksan per quintal. Aise samjho: agar aap 100 rupaiye ki cheez banaoge toh sirf ₹79 milega — ₹21 ka toh seedha ghata hai! Aur October 2025 se lekar aaj May 2026 tak — poore 7 mahine se — market lagatar MSP ke NEECHE chal rahi hai. Sarkar khud kharidi (procurement) nahi kar rahi — koi sarkari agency mandi mein makka nahi khareed rahi. Yeh structural oversupply (bahut zyada maal, kam khareedaar, sarkar bhi nahi kharid rahi) ka saaf sanket hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Jab tak sarkar procurement shuru nahi karti ya koi badi policy nahi aati, mandi ka daam MSP tak pahunche ki koi umeed nahi hai near future mein. Daam tab badhega jab ya to Iran ki ladai khatam ho, ya rabi arrivals khatam ho, ya koi bada policy announcement ho.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: ₹1,900 par becho — wait karne se aur loss hoga kyunki MSP tak aana abhi possible nahi.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Aur intezaar karo — mandi ka daam aur girega arrivals mein. May-June mein aur sasta milega.

news_items.title: India-US DDGS deal — 5 lakh tonne murgi-chaara — FSSAI ka GM barrier abhi bhi qaim — koi clearance nahi mili
news_items.category: India-US Trade — DDGS Murgi Chaara Import — FSSAI GM Status
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** America aur India ke beech February 7, 2026 ko ek saudaa hua tha — 5 lakh tonne (5,00,000 tonne — bahut bada dher) DDGS (yeh woh cheez hai jo makka se alcohol banaane ke baad bacha hua baccha hota hai — jise murgi, machhli aur bhains-gaaye ko khaana khilaate hain) bina kisi duty (bina tax) ke India aa sakta hai. Lekin FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India — India ki khaane ki safety aur jaanch ki sanstha) ka ek niyam hai ki yeh American chaara 'GM-mukht' (GM-free — matlab genetically modified — lab mein badla gaya beej se na bana ho) hona chahiye. Aaj tak koi update nahi mila — status abhi bhi 'pending' hai.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** DDGS woh bacha hua chaara hai jo makka se alcohol banaane ke baad milta hai — murgi-wale aur machh-wale isse khilaate hain. Agar yeh America se sasta aa gaya toh murgi-waale makka ki jagah yeh khareedenge — maize ki demand seedha gir jaayegi. Lekin GM barrier (FSSAI ka niyam) rok raha hai — toh abhi koi bada asar nahi hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Abhi koi immediate (abhi ki) khabar nahi hai. Lekin NAZAR rakho — agar FSSAI ne kabhi clearance de di toh murgi-waale makka NAHI khareedenge. Turant khabar aate hi becho.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: FSSAI ki khabar par dhyan rakho. Abhi koi asar nahi, par aage agar clearance aayi toh fauran becho.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Agar DDGS clearance aa gayi toh maize sasta ho jaayega — wait karke dekho.

video_news.title: Iran ki ladai mein tel $126.41 record high — makka ki ethanol demand bahut badhi — Al Jazeera report
video_news.description: Al Jazeera (ek bada international news channel) ne bataya ki Iran ki ladai mein Strait of Hormuz (samandar ka rasta jahan se duniya ka 20% tel aata hai) band hai aur tel ka daam is Guruwar $126.41 tak pahuncha — 4 saalon ka record. America aur Iran ke beech peace talks chal rahi hain lekin deal abhi tak nahi. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh bahut zaroori khabar hai — tel mehnga matlab makka se banane wali alcohol (ethanol) ki maang bahut badhti hai — distillery waale zyada maize khareedenge — daam ko support milta hai. Aaj ₹1,900 ka daam is khabar ki wajah se ₹31 upar aaya!

video_news.title: CBOT corn ZCN26 July 2026 hafte bhar mein 13.25 cents ki tezi — managed money record kharidi — Barchart report
video_news.published_display: 01 May 2026 — CBOT Corn Strong Weekly Gains
video_news.description: Barchart (America ki badi financial news website) ne bataya ki CBOT (America ka sabse bada makka bazaar) mein July 2026 ka contract ek hafte mein 13.25 cents ki tezi ke saath band hua. USDA ne confirm kiya ki March 2026 mein ethanol ke liye makka ka use 10.2% zyada hua February se — yeh bahut bada bullish signal hai. Managed money (bade fund investors) ne 79,697 naye kharidi contracts daale — total 264,103 net long hua. Kisan bhai ke liye: America ka bullish mood indirect taur par India ke NCDEX aur mandi daam ko bhi support karta hai — yeh globally makka ke liye achha time hai. Lekin rabi arrivals ka local pressure bhi dhyan rakho.

video_news.title: Bihar mein May 2026 mein above-normal rainfall aur orange alert — IMD Patna ka forecast
video_news.published_display: 01 May 2026 — IMD Bihar Orange Alert Weather Forecast
video_news.description: Patna Press (Bihar ki ek badi local news website) ne IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka mausam vibhag) ka Bihar ke liye May forecast bataya. Bihar mein May mein above-normal rainfall (zyada baarish) ki forecast hai — average 59.1mm se zyada hogi. Orange Alert jaari hai — heavy rain, thunderstorms, 60 kmph winds, hailstorms, crop damage. Temperatures below normal rahenge. Kisan bhai ke liye: baarish ek taraf aawaak ko slow karti hai (daam upar), doosri taraf geeli makka nahi bik sakti. Agar aapki makka sukhi rakh rakhi hai, aaj hi becho — baarish main ruko mat.

video_news.title: NCDEX makka ka future price May 2026 — Buy signal — Barchart futures page
video_news.published_display: 02 May 2026 — NCDEX Maize Futures Buy Signal
video_news.description: Barchart (ek badi financial data website) par NCDEX (Delhi ka sarkari fasal bazaar — jahan aage ke mahine ka makka ka daam tay hota hai) ka makka futures data milta hai. June 2026 contract ke liye Buy signal aa raha hai — matlab bade traders soch rahe hain ki daam badhenge. Aaj ka futures ~₹1,940 par hai jo Purnea mandi ke ₹1,900 se ₹40 UPAR hai. Yeh contango (futures ka spot se zyada hona) bullish sign hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: NCDEX ka ₹40 premium ek accha sign hai ki daam ko support milega — lekin rabi arrivals ka dabaav bhi nazar rakho.

video_news.title: Brent crude oil price $108.83 — Iran war ongoing — Trading Economics live data May 1 2026
video_news.description: Trading Economics (ek badi global data website) par Brent Crude oil (duniya ka benchmark kach-tel — jisse petrol-diesel banta hai) ka live price milta hai. 1 May 2026 ko $108.83 per barrel par band hua — kal se 2.02% neeche. Kisan bhai ke liye: jab tel mehnga hai aur rupaya kamzor hai, tab bahar se makka mangaana bahut mehanga ho jaata hai — is se India ka domestic (desh ka apna) makka zyada valuable ho jaata hai. Yeh makka ke liye support karta hai.

video_news.title: Brazil corn grain feed annual — USDA FAS April 2026 — production estimate 131 MMT
video_news.description: USDA FAS (America ka sarkar ka krishi vibhag — jo duniya ki fasal supply track karta hai) ne bataya ki Brazil mein 2025-26 mein 131 MMT (131 million metric tonne — bahut bada dher — 131 crore tonne) makka paidawar hui. Brazil ka domestic use 96.5 MMT aur export 43 MMT — matlab total 139.5 MMT ki zaroorat hai par sirf 131 MMT pada hai — ek chhota kami! Kisan bhai ke liye: agar Brazil mein makka kam pada toh America se zyada export hoga aur global daam upar aayenge — India par bhi thoda positive effect hoga. 12 May ko nayi WASDE report aayegi — tab Brazil ka naya estimate aayega.

video_news.title: India E20 mandate April 1 se nationwide lagu — distillery demand stable — Logical Indian article
video_news.description: The Logical Indian (ek popular news website) ne E20 mandate ka poora haal bataya. 1 April 2026 se poore India mein petrol mein 20% ethanol (alcohol — jo makka ya ganna se banti hai) milana LAZMI ho gaya. Abhi 31 din baad demand normalized ho gayi hai — distillery wale normal speed se khareed rahe hain. AIDA (All India Distillers Association — sharab banane walon ki sanstha) E30 ki maang kar raha hai. India ke ethanol mein 45.68% makka se banta hai — matlab ek permanent steady khareedaar ban gaya. Kisan bhai ke liye: E20 ek long-term acchi khabar hai — distillery waale har saal zaroor khareedenge, bus jaldi-jaldi ki rush khatam ho gayi.

video_news.title: India-US DDGS deal — 5 lakh tonne murgi chaara — FSSAI GM barrier abhi bhi — Business Standard
video_news.description: Business Standard (bada English business akhbaar) ne India-US ke beech DDGS deal ka analysis kiya. DDGS (woh bacha hua makka-chaara jo makka se alcohol banaane ke baad milta hai — murgi aur machhli ko khilaaya jaata hai) 5 lakh tonne bina tax ke aa sakta hai. Lekin FSSAI (khaane ki safety sanstha) ka GM-free certificate niyam rok raha hai. America ka DDGS GM (genetically modified — lab mein beej badla gaya) makka se banta hai — toh certificate nahi milta. Abhi tak clearance nahi mili. Kisan bhai ke liye: abhi koi khatara nahi — FSSAI niyam rok raha hai. Lekin nazar rakho — agar kabhi clearance mili toh murgi-wale makka chhodenge aur daam girega.

video_news.title: USDA WASDE April 2026 report — duniya mein makka ka zyada dher — Brazil 131 MMT — AgriWatch
video_news.published_display: 10 April 2026 — April WASDE Global Supply Update
video_news.description: AgriWatch (ek krishi news website) ke anusar April 9, 2026 ke WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — America ki sarkar ki mahine ki global fasal supply-demand report) mein duniya mein makka ki supply stable rahi. Brazil 131 MMT, Argentina 53 MMT. Agli WASDE 12 May 2026 ko aayegi — tab Brazil safrinha (doosri season ki makka) ka naya estimate aayega. Kisan bhai ke liye: duniya mein zyada maal hai lekin Iran ki ladai se supply chain disturbance hai — dono factors aapas mein cancel ho rahe hain. May 12 ki report par dhyan rakho.

video_news.title: Bihar makka mandi mein arrival update — rabi peak phase May 2026 — iGrain India
video_news.published_display: 25 March 2026 — Bihar Rabi Maize Production +15% YoY
video_news.description: iGrain India (ek badi krishi jaankari dene wali company) ne confirm kiya hai ki Bihar mein is saal makka ki paidawar pichle saal se 15% ZYADA hogi. Purnea, Khagaria, Begusarai, Samastipur APMCs mein nayi fasal aana shuru ho chuki hai. Peak arrivals phase April 5 se May 15 hai — sabse zyada maal is time mandi mein aata hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: zyada maal mandi mein aana matlab daam girna — bilkul waise jaise ek hi mela mein sab ek saath aam bechne lage toh sab sasta karne lagta hai. Jaldi becho — May 10-12 ke baad daam aur tez girega.

market_sentiment.text: Aaj ka bazaar ka mood 'mildly bullish' (thoda achha) hai — aise samjho jaise mandi mein ek taraf tazi achhi khabar aayi ho lekin doosri taraf nayi fasal ka maal bhi aane wala ho. Daam ₹31 upar aaya — lekin yeh barkat zyada din nahi tikegi. Iran ki ladai aur baarish ka support hai, lekin rabi arrivals ka dabaav bhi hai. 🟡🟢

Jab baarish rukegi, dhadi dhar maal aayega mandi mein aur daam gir jaayega. Estimate hai ki May 11 tak ₹1,842 aa sakta hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: **aaj ₹1,900 milta hai — yeh ek temporary high hai — aaj ya Monday ko becho.** Zyada rakhne ka matlab hai guaranteed loss.

Saturday ko mandi thodi dheemi hoti hai lekin daam uppar hi rahega. Kisan bhai ke liye: aaj ₹1,900 milta hai — yeh aaj ka best price hai, becho!

Din 2 (3 May, Ravivaar) — daam ₹1,900 par hi rahega kyunki Ravivaar (Sunday) ko mandi poori tarah BAND rehti hai — koi kharidi-bikri nahi hoti. Bilkul waise jaise dukaan band ho toh bahar ek bhi cheez nahi bikti. Kisan bhai ke liye: aaj aaram karo lekin kal Somwar ko subah jaldi mandi jaane ki taiyari karo — daam girne shuru ho sakte hain.

Din 3 (4 May, Somvaar) — daam ₹8 girakr ₹1,892 par aayega kyunki week ke pehle din arrivals zyada hoti hain — kisan bhai jo Sunday ko ruke the woh Somwar ko saara maal lekar aate hain. Rabi peak phase (sabse zyada fasal mandi mein aane ka time) jaari hai. Baarish thodi kum hui toh raaste bhi khule. Kisan bhai ke liye: agar kal (Sunday) nahi bech paye, toh Somwar subah pehle pahuncho mandi — ₹1,892 ka window hai.

Din 4 (5 May, Mangalvaar) — daam ₹10 aur girakr ₹1,882 par aayega kyunki nayi rabi makka mandi mein tez aawaak jaari hai — zyada maal, same khareedaar, isliye daam toot raha hai. Bilkul waise jaise ek mele mein 10 dukandaar ek hi cheez bechne lage toh sab ek doosre se sasta karne lagte hain. Kisan bhai ke liye: agar abhi tak nahi becha — aaj zaroor becho, aage aur neeche jaayega.

Din 5 (6 May, Budhvaar) — sabse tez girawat ka din — daam ₹12 girakr ₹1,870 par aayega kyunki peak arrivals phase mein sabse zyada maal in dino aata hai. Upar se Iran ke baare mein peace talks agar koi positive khabar aayi toh tel sasta hoga aur ethanol ki urgency bhi thodi kam hogi. Kisan bhai ke liye: agar kuch bhi ghar mein pada hai — aaj hi becho, kal aur sasta ho sakta hai.

Din 6 (7 May, Guruvar) — daam ₹8 aur girakr ₹1,862 par aayega — arrivals ki raftaar abhi bhi zyada hai par thodi dheemi ho rahi hai. Iran ki ladai ka uncertainty bana hua hai — tel ka support abhi bhi milta hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: ₹1,862 milega — agar quality acchi hai toh ab bhi reasonable price hai. Jo bhi bacha hai becho.

Din 7 (8 May, Shukravaar) — daam ₹8 girakr ₹1,854 par aayega — rabi arrivals abhi bhi chal rahi hai lekin agle hafte se thoda dhima hona shuru hoga. CBOT mein grain crush data bullish hai jo thoda support de raha hai — isliye girawat zyada tez nahi. Kisan bhai ke liye: Shukravaar ko bhi becho — hafte ka aakhri din hai trading ke liye, acha time hai.

Din 8 (9 May, Shanivaar) — daam sirf ₹4 girakr ₹1,850 par aayega kyunki Shanivaar ko mandi mein kaam aadha hota hai — 50% normal activity. Daam girana thoda slow. Lekin girawat ruki nahi, bas dheemi ho gayi. Kisan bhai ke liye: agar kuch bhi bacha hai — Saturday ko bhi becho.

Din 9 (10 May, Ravivaar) — daam ₹1,850 par hi rahega — Sunday ko mandi BAND hai. Koi badlav nahi. Lekin Monday ko America ki WASDE report (duniya ki sabse badi fasal supply report) se ek din pehle bazaar thodi soch-samajh mein rehta hai — traders wait-and-watch karte hain. Kisan bhai ke liye: aaj aaram karo, kal bada din hai — WASDE report ka intezaar hai.

Din 10 (11 May, Somvaar) — daam ₹8 girakr ₹1,842 par aayega — WASDE report kal (12 May) aane wali hai toh kuch cautious traders wait kar rahe hain. Bihar mein rabi arrivals tapering (kum hona) shuru ho rahi hai lekin abhi completely band nahi. Tel ka daam Iran ke haalaat par depend kar raha hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: ₹1,842 mein khareedne waalon ke liye yeh ek accha entry point hai — ab daam zyada girne ki ummeed kam hai. Bechne wale: agar kuch bhi raka hai — aaj hi bech do, WASDE ke baad aur uncertainty ho sakti hai.

Lekin agar kabhi FSSAI ne clearance di toh murgi-waale (poultry farms — jo Bihar mein bahut hain) makka ki jagah yeh sasta chaara khareedenge — seedha demand loss hoga. Abhi latent (chhupa hua) risk hai — watch karo. POTENTIAL BEARISH.
bullish: Iran ki ladai (February 28 se) mein Strait of Hormuz (samandar ka zaroori rasta — jahan se duniya ka 20% tel aata hai) abhi bhi band hai. Brent Crude (duniya ka benchmark tel) is hafte $126.41 tak pahuncha — 4 saalon ka record! Aaj $108.83 par hai. Jab tel $90 se upar hota hai toh sarkar aur distillery waale makka se ethanol (petrol mein milane wali alcohol) banana bahut ZAROORI samajhte hain — makka ki demand bahut badhti hai. E20 mandate (April 1 se petrol mein 20% ethanol lazmi) aur $108 ka tel mil ke makka ko bahut important bana dete hain. STRONGLY BULLISH.

CBOT (America ka sabse bada makka bazaar) mein July 2026 contract ek hafte mein 13.25 cents ki tezi ke saath ₹480.25 cents par band hua. Managed money investors (bade fund managers) ne 79,697 naye kharidi contracts daale — ab 264,103 net long hain. USDA ke anusar March mein ethanol grind (makka se alcohol banana) 10.2% ZYADA hua. NCDEX (Delhi ka bada fasal bazaar) bhi Buy signal de raha hai ₹1,940 par — Purnea ke ₹1,900 se ₹40 UPAR. Yeh global aur domestic bullish signals ek saath aa rahe hain. BULLISH.

IMD Orange Alert ki wajah se Bihar mein baarish aur hailstorm — nayi fasal mandi mein aana RUKA hai kuch dino ke liye. Aaj Saturday ko mandi mein maal kam aaya — daam ko support mila. May 2026 mein above-normal rainfall forecast hai — iska matlab hai ki arrivals kabhi tez kabhi dheemi hongi. Jab bhi baarish hogi, daam temporarily upar aayega. SHORT TERM BULLISH — agle 2-3 din.

E20 mandate ab permanent structural demand ban gaya hai — April 1 se poore India mein petrol mein 20% ethanol lazmi hai. India ke ethanol mein 45.68% makka ka hissa hai. Distillery wale ab normal speed se lekin REGULARLY khareed rahe hain. AIDA (All India Distillers Association) E30 ki maang kar raha hai — agar aayi toh aur badi demand badhegi. Yeh ek permanent floor (neeche ka base daam) banata hai makka ke liye. MEDIUM TERM BULLISH.

India ka rupaya (INR) aaj ₹94.89 per dollar par chal raha hai — yeh record low ke kareeeb hai. Jab rupaya kamzor hota hai toh bahar se maal mangaana bahut mehanga ho jaata hai. Koi bhi India mein makka baahir se nahi mangaayega kyunki import parity (bahar se laana kitna sasta hoga) ₹2,200+ per quintal tak pahunch jaata hai — Purnea ka ₹1,900 us se bahut sasta hai. Isliye koi import ka dabaav nahi hai. MILD BULLISH.
neutral: WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — America ki sarkar ki monthly global fasal supply-demand report) 12 May ko aayegi — yeh ek important event hai. April 9 wali report mein Brazil 131 MMT dikhaya tha. Agar 12 May ko Brazil zyada ya kam dikhaya toh India ke daam par bhi asar hoga. Abhi koi nahi jaanta — toh yeh neutral factor hai. Market wait-and-watch mein hai. NEUTRAL — abhi koi asar nahi, May 12 ke baad badlav aayega.

Brazil safrinha (doosri season ki makka — jo August mein kategi) ki status abhi uncertain hai. January 2026 mein boi thodi late thi — 76% complete. Agar April-May mein sukha mausam aaya toh Brazil mein paidawar kam ho sakti hai — yeh global daam ke liye bullish hoga. Agar theek raha toh bearish. Abhi koi confirmed news nahi — isliye neutral. May 12 ki WASDE report mein clarity aayegi. NEUTRAL — potential upside risk.
